How do I get my WhatsApp link?
Use wa.me/ plus your number in international format, no plus sign, no spaces — e.g. wa.me/15551234567. You can also add ?text=Hello to prefill a message.
Can I prefill a message?
Yes — append ?text=Your%20message to the wa.me link. When someone scans, the chat opens with your text ready to send.
Do I need WhatsApp Business?
No. A personal number works the same way. WhatsApp Business adds catalogs and auto-replies, but the QR code works with either.
